now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3#16
now.text: May lures Giyera into a room where his powers are useless and beats him hand to hand. Held prisoner aboard Zephyr One, he breaks free, hijacks the plane and forces it down at a Hydra base, leaving May badly wounded.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Hive's telekinetic soldier. Loses to May hand to hand, then hijacks her plane.
now.on_b_card_about_a: The agent who beats Giyera hand to hand, then is badly hurt when he hijacks her plane.

proposed.text: Coulson lures Giyera into an empty room where May is waiting, and she beats him hand to hand. Held prisoner aboard Zephyr One, he breaks free, hijacks the plane and forces it down at a Hydra base, leaving May badly wounded.

changes.evidence: In Paradise Lost (S3#16) Coulson ambushes Giyera's team and runs, drawing Giyera into a locked empty room with no objects to throw; May is the one waiting inside and knocks him out. The lure is Coulson, not May.

now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3#17
now.text: Jemma Simmons studies Yo-Yo's speed when she first comes to S.H.I.E.L.D., and the two become friends.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Studies Yo-Yo's speed when Yo-Yo first comes to S.H.I.E.L.D. The two become friends.
now.on_b_card_about_a: A new arrival at S.H.I.E.L.D. whose speed Jemma studies. They become friends.

proposed.text: After Lincoln is locked up as Hive's suspected spy, Yo-Yo gives Jemma blood samples to test for Hive's infection, then demands to be let go from S.H.I.E.L.D.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: S.H.I.E.L.D. scientist who tests Yo-Yo's blood for Hive's infection.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Secret Warrior who gives Jemma blood samples, then walks out on S.H.I.E.L.D.

changes.evidence: In The Team (S3#17) Yo-Yo's only scene with Simmons is giving her blood samples before demanding to leave S.H.I.E.L.D.; nothing shows Jemma studying her speed, and Yo-Yo first came to S.H.I.E.L.D. in Bouncing Back (S3#11), not here. She leaves angry and distrustful, so 'the two become friends' is not this episode either. The only 'physical assessment' by Fitz and Simmons is in the Slingshot web series, not the show.

now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3#17
now.text: After a hard year apart, with Fitz hurt and Jemma undercover in HYDRA, Fitz never stops trying to bring her home from the planet Maveth. Once she is back, they finally become a couple.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Jemma's boyfriend, who never stopped trying to bring her home from Maveth.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Fitz's girlfriend, whom he brings home from Maveth after a year apart.

proposed.text: While talking over what Hive could mean for their Inhuman friends, Fitz and Jemma share a tender kiss and finally become a couple.

changes.evidence: The text sums up earlier episodes (the year apart and Jemma undercover in Hydra are S2#1-10; Fitz bringing her home from Maveth is S3#1-5). What happens between them in The Team (S3#17) is the kiss that starts their relationship, after their talk about Hive and the Inhumans. The card lines stay true and point back, so they are kept.

owner_calls.question: With the S3#17 text corrected to the blood test, should the first Yo-Yo/Jemma stage stay a 'friend' stage starting here, or should the friendship begin at a later title?
options: Keep kind 'friend' at S3#17 with the corrected text
Change this stage's kind to 'ally' and let the friendship start at S5#15 (or a S5 title where they are stranded in the future together)
owner_calls.evidence: In The Team Yo-Yo leaves S.H.I.E.L.D. angry right after giving Simmons blood samples; nothing between the two of them in that episode is friendly.
